newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Siu-Fung down to year low on rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Siu-Fung down to year low on rights plan.

text.p: Shares of Siu-fung Ceramics Holdings Ltd fell on Monday after the company announced a HK$400 million rights issue plan and called off its U.S. spinoff plan.

"The company's move of calling off its U.S. listing plan disappointed investors and that triggered selling, especially on dilution fear on the company's rights issue plan," said a dealing director at a regional brokerage.
Siu-Fung shares fell HK$0.10 or 13.51 percent to a year low of HK$0.64 each before steadying at HK$0.66 in mid-morning on volume of HK$10.30 million shares worth HK$6.88 million.

Siu-fung, which earlier reported an interim net loss of HK$252.19 million for the first half of 1996, proposed a rights issue of 575.09 million new shares at HK$0.70 each on the basis of two rights shares for every five existing shares held.
The company also said it had abandoned its U.S. spinoff plan due to ongoing operational restructuring programmes of its subsidiaries in Europe.
